summary: Steele Creek Capital Corp filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that its Board of Directors declared a quarterly dividend of $0.1287 per share on the company's issued and outstanding common stock on August 17, 2026. The dividend is payable October 15, 2026 to holders of record as of the close of business on August 19, 2026. No special-situation event, transaction, or advisory involvement is present; the filing also notes the registrant is a Maryland corporation and former MSC Capital LLC, with CFO Douglas S. Applegate, Jr. signing. No merger, tender, activist, or capital-structure action is implicated.
